evidenceNotes: Current main is PR #142 squash 7d21667eddac29804cea9aa13077618a52e09768; its GitHub Pages run 32857591617 completed successfully.

Stage 4 contracts now require full/selectable/copyable recovery behavior and explicitly reject a pair_ plus 32-hex shortened identifier.
